final.summary: The ETP was stopped from the afternoon of 13 October while dyeing wastewater kept arriving, and untreated alkaline water was discharged at the outfall that evening. Outfall pH reached strongly alkaline levels while outfall flow exceeded treated flow by hundreds of cubic metres, showing the batch wastewater did not go through working treatment before discharge.

key_evidence.why: Power at standby level through the stop shows the ETP was stopped, not running normally.
Outfall pH near 11 shows raw alkaline wastewater reached the outfall, not treated effluent.
Outfall flow resumes while ETP inflow stays at zero shows discharge bypassed the ETP.
Outfall exceeded treated flow by 213.6 m3, quantifying untreated discharge.
Conductivity stayed high with extra flow, ruling out dilution as the explanation.
Photo reading matches the feed, so the stop is real and not a power meter fault.

final.scope_line: Based on flow, power, pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 10:00 to 2026-10-14 14:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
limitations: Equalization tank level T1 has no coverage over the treatment interval, so tank storage change cannot be computed and the tank balance is unknown.

ETP inflow and outfall flow were flat at zero from 2026-10-13 13:50 to 2026-10-13 19:20 and 2026-10-13 13:50 to 2026-10-13 22:50 respectively; flat stretches limit exact timing but do not change the finding.
Power after 2026-10-13 23:00 was not checked within the check budget, so later aeration performance is not assessed.
Factory logbook, maintenance record and operator statement are claims, not facts; the logbook claim of normal running at 22:00 is contradicted by the signals.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
